# Elise Sheinberg, MPH, RDN

Elise Sheinberg is a fourth-year PhD candidate in Population Health Sciences (Public Health Nutrition) in the Department of Nutrition at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, advised by Cindy W. Leung, and a registered dietitian nutritionist. She studies how federal nutrition programs, especially SNAP and SNAP-matching nutrition incentive programs, affect food security, diet quality, and chronic disease.
